metadata.title: Nvidia Stock Is Too Cheap. Apple Once Had the Same Problem.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia Stock Is Starting to Look a Lot Like 2010s Apple
Nvidia’s earnings report this past week had something to offer everyone—the bulls, the bears, and the AI-curious who may still fall somewhere in between.
